notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Egyptian Prophecy: The Fate of Ramses, 33% off!
notes.content:
The Egyptian Prophecy: The Fate of Ramses is Now Available on Steam and is 33% off!*

A point-and-click adventure game using 360° views, similar to Jules Verne’s Return to Mysterious Island and Dracula: The Path of the Dragon.

You play the role of a young magician and help her investigate the mysteries of ancient Egypt.



Can you solve the Fate of Ramses?

*Offer ends June 13 at 10AM Pacific Time
